answers.core:
This can be provided by an add-on, but making it core will improve performance in large and complex RichTextLabels (as there won't be a need to call a GDScript function for every glyph within a `[pulse]` tag every frame).

RichTextLabel already offers a few built-in effects like `[wave]`, `[shake]` and `[rainbow]`, but these are arguably *far* more situational.

title: Add a `[pulse]` built-in effect to RichTextLabel
